title: 2.1 Transformations of Quadratic Functions

icans: I can describe transformations of f(x) = x².
I can find the vertex of a transformed quadratic function and graph it.
I can write rules for quadratic functions after transformations.

vocab: the U-shaped graph of a ____________ function

blocks.p: Graph y = a(x − h)² + k in Desmos with sliders. Describe what each one does.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Vertex form: f(x) = a(x − h)² + k has vertex _______________.
Translations: h > 0 moves the graph _______________; k > 0 moves it _______________.

blocks.stem: Describe the transformation of f(x) = x² represented by g(x) = (x + 4)² − 2. Then graph g.
Describe the transformation of f(x) = x² represented by g(x) = −½x² + 3. Give the vertex.
Let g be a vertical stretch by a factor of 3 of f(x) = x², followed by a translation 1 unit right and 5 units up. Write a rule for g.
The height h (in feet) of a kicked ball is h(x) = −0.03(x − 14)² + 6, where x is the horizontal distance (in feet). Describe the transformation of f(x) = x². What is the ball’s maximum height?
Describe the transformation of f(x) = x² represented by g(x) = 2(x − 3)². Give the vertex.
Write a rule for g, a reflection in the x-axis of f(x) = x² followed by a translation 4 units down.

tickets.stem: What is the vertex of g(x) = (x + 1)² − 6?
Describe the transformation of f(x) = x² represented by g(x) = x² + 8.
Write a rule for f(x) = x² translated 2 units left.
